basic_profile.bio: Avid Animal Crossing fan based in Oregon, USA. Passionate about DIY crafting within the game and enjoys sharing and collecting unique designs. Outside of gaming, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me a flexible schedule. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after 7 PM PST. I'm in a long-term relationship and we both enjoy playing co-op games together.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital arts and design, having completed a bachelor's degree in graphic design. I've been self-teaching myself various crafting techniques within games like Animal Crossing. Additionally, I am an active participant in online communities where I learn and share DIY tips.
